summary: @onereach/or-browser-next preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs (variables minified as _0xNNNN) detects the host platform/arch, downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods the binary, then execFileSyncs it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a single-line 727KB payload obfuscated with string-array rotation (function WV8StW) and a custom base64 alphabet decoder (hc1jfK9), bearing no relation to the package's advertised Vue browsing UI component. The Bun runtime is used specifically to execute an opaque bundle that Node-resolved static scanners would not inspect, and it runs automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
